spider.name: Spider
spider.text: Solves problems through calculation and secret deals, holding the threads of contacts and favors.
spider.xpTrigger: Gain xp when you address a challenge with calculation or conspiracy.
list: What should I look into more closely?
What are they about to do?
How can I get them to [X]?

foresight.name: Foresight
foresight.text: Twice per score, assist a teammate for free, explaining how you anticipated the problem.

calculating.name: Calculating
calculating.text: In downtime, +1 action for yourself or a teammate; if unused, you may flashback during a score.

connected.name: Connected
connected.text: In downtime, +1 result level when acquiring assets or reducing heat.

functioning-vice.name: Functioning Vice
functioning-vice.text: When you indulge your vice, shift the dice result by 1 or 2; an ally who joins you does too.

ghost-contract.name: Ghost Contract
ghost-contract.text: Parties to a contract are marked; a violator takes level 3 harm "Cursed".

jail-bird.name: Jail Bird
jail-bird.text: In prison, wanted level is 1 lower, crew tier is 1 higher, +1 to your relationship with an organization.

mastermind.name: Mastermind
mastermind.text: Special armor: protect a teammate (without being present), or push yourself when gathering information and on projects.

weaving-the-web.name: Weaving the Web
weaving-the-web.text: +1d to Consort when gathering information on a target and to the engagement roll for that score.

fine-cover-identity.name: Fine Cover Identity
fine-cover-identity.text: Documents, stories and rumors that let you pass as someone else.

blueprints.name: Blueprints
blueprints.text: City maps and building plans; you choose which structures.

vial-of-slumber-essence.name: Vial of Slumber Essence
vial-of-slumber-essence.text: A sleeping draught, deep sleep for an hour; the sleeper can be woken with effort.

concealed-palm-pistol.name: Concealed Palm Pistol
concealed-palm-pistol.text: A tiny weapon with a range of a few paces, hard to find in a search.

salia.name: Salia
salia.text: A reliable contact on criminal matters, or a former partner who double-crossed you.

augus.name: Augus
augus.text: A consultant on layouts and history, or an opponent who designs new defenses.

jenna.name: Jenna
jenna.text: An informant on the affairs of the nobility.

jeren.name: Jeren
jeren.text: A double agent in the watch, or a curious officer.
